A four-phase and an eight-phase signal constellation are shown in the figure
below. For the constraint that the minimum distance between pairs of signal points be
d for both constellations, the radii [latex]r_{1}[/latex], and [latex]r_{2}[/latex] of the circles are
questions.explanation: For M-ary [latex] d=2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{M}\right) \sqrt{E_{s}}[/latex] Distance of any point from origin is [latex]\sqrt{E}_{s} [/latex] [latex] \begin{aligned} \text{For, 4-ary}, r_{1}&=\sqrt{E_{s_{1}}} \\ 8-\text { ary, } \quad r_{2}&=\sqrt{E_{s_{2}}}\\ \text { For, } 4-\text { ary } M=4, d_{1}&=2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right) r_{1} \\ 8-\text { ary } M=8 ; d_{2}&=2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right) r_{2} \end{aligned}[/latex] [latex] \begin{array}{l} \text { if } d_{1}=d_{2}=d \text { then } \\ 2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right) r_{1}=d \Rightarrow r_{1}=\frac{d}{\sqrt{2}}=0,707 d \\ 2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right) r_{2}=d \\ \Rightarrow r_{2}=\frac{d}{2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right)}=1.307 d \end{array}[/latex]
questions.explanation_html:
For M-ary
[latex] d=2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{M}\right) \sqrt{E_{s}}[/latex]
Distance of any point from origin is [latex]\sqrt{E}_{s} [/latex]
[latex] \begin{aligned} \text{For, 4-ary}, r_{1}&=\sqrt{E_{s_{1}}} \\ 8-\text { ary, } \quad r_{2}&=\sqrt{E_{s_{2}}}\\ \text { For, } 4-\text { ary } M=4, d_{1}&=2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right) r_{1} \\ 8-\text { ary } M=8 ; d_{2}&=2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right) r_{2} \end{aligned}[/latex]
[latex] \begin{array}{l} \text { if } d_{1}=d_{2}=d \text { then } \\ 2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right) r_{1}=d \Rightarrow r_{1}=\frac{d}{\sqrt{2}}=0,707 d \\ 2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right) r_{2}=d \\ \Rightarrow r_{2}=\frac{d}{2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right)}=1.307 d \end{array}[/latex]
